subject: maths
question: The ratio of the present age of the two brothers is 11 ∶ 13 and 6 years ago the ratio of their ages was 4 ∶ 5. What will be the ratio of their ages after 5 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Present Age Ratio of Brothers = 11 : 13

Let the present ages be 11x and 13x.

6 years ago, the ratio of their ages = 4 : 5

**Calculations:**

Age of the first brother 6 years ago = 11x - 6

Age of the second brother 6 years ago = 13x - 6

Using the ratio: (11x - 6) / (13x - 6) = 4 / 5

⇒ 5(11x - 6) = 4(13x - 6)

⇒
